caption: This graphite drawing on a beige background depicts an ornate vessel with a square cup at the top, which has a single highly decorative handle attached to one side. The cup features a detailed image of a double-headed eagle in relief on its visible face, with other ornamental designs on the sides. Supporting the cup is a stem with a bulbous, ornamented midsection, decorated with a row of oval shapes near its upper rim and floral-like motifs below. The object stands on a multi-tiered, square-based pedestal. The broad base flares outward, and its sides are adorned with an engraved dragon figure and additional decorative scrollwork. A smaller, simplified line drawing of the same object appears to the left of the main drawing, providing an alternate perspective. There is a scale at the bottom of the image for measurement reference. The artwork is rendered entirely in pencil, with varying shades of gray used to represent shading and detail.
title: Silver Snuffer Stand
